criteria.no: No compliance claim is made, or it is a bare assertion or future intention with no checkable support.
criteria.unclear: The text gives mutually ambiguous information and neither yes nor no can be established.
criteria.yes: A named test, command, file/diff or concrete output is cited to support the implemented complete zero-false-alarm outcome.

evidenced.instructions: Read only the described item: is a successful check, named test, command, diff or path cited as support for the claimed zero-false-alarm implementation?

criteria.no: The outcome is absent, merely discussed, planned for later, or a forbidden false alarm is explicitly retained.
criteria.unclear: The text gives mutually ambiguous information and neither yes nor no can be established.
criteria.yes: The account says the entire required outcome is already implemented; proof is judged separately.

implemented.instructions: Read only the described item: does the account say the complete unexcluded-atm-core zero-false-alarm outcome for both #786 classes has been built? A future plan does not count.

criteria.no: The item is unrelated to PORT-010 or its scoped consumer behavior.
criteria.unclear: The text gives mutually ambiguous information and neither yes nor no can be established.
criteria.yes: The item concerns PORT-010, its fixtures or docs, or atm-core exclusions and findings.

relevant.instructions: Read only the described item: is the item within `anchor.scope` by changing or investigating PORT-010 or its consumer exclusions? Ignore whether it complies.

criteria.no: No incompatible behavior is stated. Silence, investigation, and reporting genuine Windows parity gaps are not conflict.
criteria.unclear: The text gives mutually ambiguous information and neither yes nor no can be established.
criteria.yes: The item explicitly preserves at least one forbidden finding, or keeps/reintroduces path exclusions as the solution.

violated.instructions: Read only the described item: does the described approach conflict with zero #786-table false-alarm findings on unexcluded atm-core? Judge explicit incompatible behavior only.
